name: @flighthq/flight-hx
description: Haxe bindings for the Flight SDK: one flight.* surface over C++ (flight-cpp), ESM (flight-js), and an optional transpiled-Haxe fallback.

scripts.proof: node tools/haxe.mjs -cp src -cp tests/haxe --main ProofOfShape --interp -D flight_hx
scripts.check: npm run rehydrate:check && npm run gate:proof
